name: Mantis St Helena
desc: Mantis St Helena is a 30-bedroom boutique hotel set in the original East India Company's officers' barracks built in 1774. The Hotel boasts a large restaurant, cocktail bar, guest lounge and two spacious outdoor terraces. Offering luxurious heritage rooms and suites and newly built contemporary rooms, Mantis has set a new accommodation standard on the island. Situated in the capital Jamestown, a few minute's walk…
